version_adaptations_and_limits.reference: Original FCFS-MPQ sorts by immutable Req.arrival_time supplied by the tokenizer manager.
version_adaptations_and_limits.adaptation: Current API created_time is not serialized into the scheduler. Use the existing immutable SchedulerReqTimeStats.scheduler_recv_time, which ordinary retraction does not reset. Avoid wait_queue_entry_time, which resets on requeue; no new Req field is added.
version_adaptations_and_limits.limit: Orders by first scheduler receipt instead of original tokenizer/API arrival; necessary adaptation to the current runtime timestamp propagation.

version_adaptations_and_limits.adaptation: Keep modern Req.init_next_round_input last-token/logprob/embedding safety and native single continuing chunked-request path. Existing chunk continuation is accounted for outside the selected MPQ group quota.
version_adaptations_and_limits.limit: Original Preble chunk-budget scheduling and modern PrefillAdder need not form identical model batches.

version_adaptations_and_limits.reference: Original schedule_within_group can continue past an ordinary non-fitting request, but breaks after lock-related capacity failure.
version_adaptations_and_limits.adaptation: Leave the current runtime PrefillAdder result handling intact: the scheduler breaks when admission returns a non-CONTINUE result.
version_adaptations_and_limits.limit: Token-budget/capacity exhaustion can therefore differ from original admission behavior; no unrelated runtime rewrite is included.

interpretation: Global differential replay matched the pinned reference including six shared finish assertion failures: 9,012 selections/finish attempts, 9,006 successful finishes. Shared assertion failures are not successful requests. MPQ reports 5,000 scheduling decisions, frontend29 cases, and archived-arrival replay3 real localhost HTTP requests. These CPU/transport checks do not constitute a small-model benchmark or a claim that all upstream paths are bug-free.
known_limit: Original bugs deliberately retained for reference parity are described in the global report. Native GPU allocation and modern PrefillAdder batch construction are necessary runtime adaptations; exact original model batches are not promised.
